title: Neo brutalist
description: Yellow stage with hard-edged white cards, a date badge and a coloured image panel. The image side alternates (:nth-child(even)) and the panel colour cycles through the entries.

entry.css: .nb-card{display:flex;align-items:stretch;background:#fff;border:3px solid #111;box-shadow:8px 8px 0 #111;font-family:"Courier New",ui-monospace,monospace;color:#111}.nb-card__body{flex:1 1 55%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:24px 26px;min-width:0}.nb-card__panel{position:relative;flex:1 1 45%;min-height:200px;border-left:3px solid #111;overflow:hidden}.nb-card__panel img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.nb-card__shape{position:absolute;inset:18% 22%;border:3px solid #111;border-radius:50%;background:#fff}.nb-card__date{position:absolute;z-index:1;top:12px;left:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:6px 12px;background:#111;color:#fff;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;font-size:.85em}.nb-card__date strong{font-size:1.7em}.nb-card__chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.nb-card .swp-chip{padding:2px 10px;border:2px solid #111;background:#c9a7ff;font-size:.7em;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase}.nb-card__title{margin:0;font-family:Impact,"Arial Black","Helvetica Neue",sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.3em,2.4vw,2em);line-height:1.1;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:900}.nb-card__title a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.nb-card__text{margin:0;font-size:.88em;line-height:1.55}.nb-card__foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:auto;padding-top:14px;border-top:2px dashed #111;font-size:.8em}.nb-card__button{padding:8px 16px;background:#111;color:#fff;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}
